_about: What 'right' looks like, from fixes Sir accepted. Per rule: values (the accepted numbers), exemplars (a library entry {lib} or a place {spot} in the approved state today, shown beside that rule's problems), fixCommits (an accepted after-state: tools/review/validate_fixes.js runs the checkers there; the rule must stay quiet on that entry/spot, and should fire on hash^). Lab-era commits (before the shops were grafted into the game, ~2026-09-10) are listed as refs only, without an entry to test. Commits of 2026-10-28/29 are provisional: confirm on the iPad first.

exemplars.why: every box and slab the right way out

K2.values: nothing crosses a door's surround (a0-4..a1+4, up to the head at z + 107.95 + 7 lab = 114.95); lay windows out from the returned, clamped door

exemplars.why: set out from the door: 12 / 54 / 10 / 54 / 12 / door / 13.76

K3.values: glass with goods behind it: tint .30-.46 (Saltwater Sweets .30, Driftwood Books .32, Marina Optical .36, Tidewater News .38, Low Tide TV & Radio .46); an empty or barred pane may stay opaque (.80-.90)

K4.values: a-range in 0..WW; proud: a-b-r >= 0 and a+b+r <= WW; a set-back board needs |b|+6 of margin (Tidewater News 16 vs depth 9); a canopy may overhang the return by <= 12; full-width bands run 0..WW with bBack 0

exemplars.why: every board inside its lot on both mirrored edges

K5.values: the panel sits +0.5 proud of its board and the letters +0.3 proud of the panel (Tidewater News: board -1, panel -0.5, letters -0.2); pass blockWord bb = the board's front

K7.values: everything rests on, hangs from or fixes to a drawn solid: rooftop z0 = H, finial on the apex, bulbs on the fascia

exemplars.why: pipe standing on the roof deck

K8.values: street-seen fixtures (sign, lamp, clock, pipe, banner, emblem) have their whole b-range >= 0; roof plant at b -60..-100 standing on H is fine

K12.values: piers between openings 10-14; at a return >= 4.5 (Marina Tailors' 4.76 on a 170 frontage accepted); fault < 4.5, warning < 10

D0.values: every door is the kit's shopDoor (66.24 x 161.92) or houseDoorway (92 x 184): it opens and people come through it
